scenario: LUNI.8.6 — typed-let annotation must match the RHS dimension when the RHS has a static dim. `let x: meter = r.temp` (annotation length vs RHS temperature) rejects with DS_VALIDATE_LET_DIM_MISMATCH. Drives `dsc.validate.luni_8_6_unit_annotation`'s dimension arm with no `implicit` bridge. An untyped right-hand side does not admit (LUNI.8.6_typed_let_untyped_rhs_refused), and a dimension product a unit annotation names does ([LUNI.8.4], LUNI.8.6_typed_let_unit_ok).
rules_ds:
unit celsius: temperature = x + 273.15

schema Reading scope logical:
    temp: celsius key

rule bad:
    Reading r
->
    let x: meter = r.temp
    log info "never"
